plan: To preserve capital, sell all leveraged ETFs (METU, MSFU, SOXL, SPAL, PLTU, MUU) to zero.
Trim SPY to 20% to reduce concentration and align with the conservative mandate.
This plan focuses on de-risking the portfolio by eliminating high-beta and leveraged positions.
It prioritizes capital preservation and reduces exposure to downtrending assets.
conservative.read: This conservative plan aims for a modest ~1.5%/month target, prioritizing capital preservation. It significantly reduces risk by cutting all leveraged ETFs and trimming concentrated positions. Expect lower drawdowns but also limited upside potential.

plan: For balanced growth, trim all leveraged ETFs (METU, MSFU, SOXL, SPAL, PLTU, MUU) to zero.
Trim SPY to 25% to reduce concentration and align with the mandate.
Add TECS at 4% as a strong scanner long setup to introduce new, high-potential exposure.
This plan balances risk reduction with targeted growth opportunities.
balanced.read: This balanced plan targets ~2.5%/month, focusing on risk-first growth. It reduces overall leverage and concentration while introducing a high-quality long setup. Expect moderate drawdowns and a balanced approach to market exposure.

plan: For aggressive growth, trim SPY to 25% and QQQI to 25% to meet concentration limits.
Maintain current positions in QQQ, CRWD, and SMH, despite flags, to preserve existing exposure.
Add TECS at 6% and SQQQ at 6% as high-scoring scanner long setups to increase aggressive exposure.
This plan leans into high-conviction setups and maintains existing positions for growth potential.
aggressive.read: This aggressive plan targets ~4%/month, aiming for stretch growth. It uses leverage and concentrates in high-scoring setups, which significantly raises both upside and drawdown potential. Be aware that leveraged ETFs decay daily, and this approach can lead to substantial losses quickly if stops are not strictly adhered to.

plan: For income, sell all leveraged ETFs (METU, MSFU, SOXL, SPAL, PLTU, MUU) to zero.
Trim SPY to 20% to reduce concentration and free up capital.
Add to QQQI, bringing it to 30% of the book, to prioritize steady monthly distributions.
This plan focuses on low drawdown and reliable income over growth.
income.read: This income plan targets ~1%/month, prioritizing yield and capital preservation. It significantly reduces high-beta and leveraged exposure, rotating into income-focused ETFs. While aiming for reliable distributions, remember that NAV can still fall in selloffs, and distributions are variable.
